module_summary: 2-bit ripple-carry adder made of two chained add1 instances, the low bit's carry Co_temp feeding the high bit.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Operand A, split per bit into the two add1 cells.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Operand B, split per bit into the two add1 cells.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 2-bit sum assembled from the two add1 outputs.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Internal ripple carry from bit-0 adder into bit-1 adder.

anchors.name: Co
anchors.why: Carry-out from the high-bit add1 cell.

anchors.name: Cin
anchors.why: Carry-in feeding the bit-0 add1 cell.

groups.name: ripple_adder
groups.description: Two cascaded 1-bit adders with internal ripple carry.
